nodes.label: Part I
nodes.description: Business overview, risk factors, properties and legal matters of the company.

children.label: Item 1. Business
children.description: Description of the company's business: its products and services, customers, competition, employees and regulation.

children.label: Item 1A. Risk Factors
children.description: Discussion of the most significant risks that could harm the company's business, finances or stock price.

children.label: Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments
children.description: Disclosure of unresolved comments from the SEC staff on the company's earlier filings.

children.label: Item 2. Properties
children.description: Description of the company's principal physical properties, such as offices, plants, stores and real estate.

children.label: Item 3. Legal Proceedings
children.description: Description of material pending legal proceedings and litigation involving the company.

children.label: Item 4. Mine Safety Disclosures
children.description: Disclosure of mine safety violations and related regulatory information for mining operations.

nodes.label: Part II
nodes.description: Market information, financial results and management's analysis, financial statements and controls.

children.label: Item 5. Market for Registrant's Common Equity, Related Stockholder Matters and Issuer Purchases of Equity Securities
children.description: Market for the company's common stock, number of holders, dividends, securities authorized for equity compensation plans, share repurchases and stock performance graph.

children.label: Item 6. Selected Financial Data
children.description: Summary table of selected financial data for the last five years.

children.label: Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations
children.description: Management's discussion of results of operations, liquidity, capital resources, critical accounting estimates and trends.

children.label: Item 7A. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk
children.description: Exposure to market risks such as interest rate, foreign currency and commodity price risk.

children.label: Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data
children.description: The audited financial statements, auditor's report, notes to the financial statements and supplementary data.

children.label: Item 9. Changes in and Disagreements with Accountants on Accounting and Financial Disclosure
children.description: Disclosure of any changes in or disagreements with the company's independent accountants.

children.label: Item 9A. Controls and Procedures
children.description: Evaluation of disclosure controls and procedures and management's report on internal control over financial reporting.

children.label: Item 9B. Other Information
children.description: Other information required to be disclosed that was not reported in another filing.

nodes.label: Part III
nodes.description: Directors, executive officers, compensation, ownership, related transactions and auditor fees.

children.label: Item 10. Directors, Executive Officers and Corporate Governance
children.description: Information about the company's directors, executive officers, code of ethics, audit committee and corporate governance.

children.label: Item 11. Executive Compensation
children.description: Compensation of the company's executive officers and directors, including salary, bonuses, equity awards and compensation policies.

children.label: Item 12. Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners and Management and Related Stockholder Matters
children.description: Stock ownership of large shareholders, directors and officers, and equity compensation plan information.

children.label: Item 13. Certain Relationships and Related Transactions, and Director Independence
children.description: Transactions between the company and its insiders or related parties, and the independence of directors.

children.label: Item 14. Principal Accountant Fees and Services
children.description: Fees paid to the independent auditor and the audit committee's pre-approval policies.

children.label: Item 15. Exhibits and Financial Statement Schedules
children.description: List of exhibits filed with the report, financial statement schedules and index to the financial statements.
